fields.climate: tropical; rainy season (November to April), dry season (May to October)
fields.terrain: two main islands (Savaii, Upolu) and several smaller islands and uninhabited islets; narrow coastal plain with volcanic, rugged mountains in interior
fields.hazards: occasional cyclones; active volcanism; volcanism: Savai'I Island (1,858 m) is historically active
fields.farm: coconuts, bananas, taro, tropical fruits, pineapples, mangoes/guavas, papayas, root vegetables, milk, avocados
fields.exports: refined petroleum, integrated circuits, coconut oil, fish, insulated wire
fields.industries: food processing, building materials, auto parts
fields.religions: Protestant 54.9% (Congregationalist 29%, Methodist 12.4%, Assembly of God 6.8%, Seventh Day Adventist 4.4%, other Protestant 2.3%), Roman Catholic 18.8%, Church of Jesus Christ 16.9%, Worship Centre…
fields.legal: mixed system of English common law and customary law; judicial review of legislative acts involving fundamental citizen rights
